claims.claim: vfat0 (vfat.eth) posted "Lets do this again then" on X on 2026-09-01 linking to vfat.tools' Ripe Protocol farm tracker on Robinhood Chain
Robinhood Chain is an Arbitrum Orbit-based optimistic rollup (chain ID 4663) with EIP-4844 blobs, fraud proofs, and a 7-day withdrawal challenge window

Robinhood Chain governance is an 8-signer Security Council with Robinhood holding 2 of 8 seats; L2Beat characterizes it as a 7-of-8 multisig that can act as direct executor bypassing the timelock, and flags EOA-upgradeable critical contracts

Robinhood Chain TVL figures diverge materially by source and methodology: DefiLlama historical API $310M (Jul 21) to $738M (Jul 31); live DefiLlama snapshot $727.4M chain TVL with $2.4B bridged assets (Sep 1); The Block reported >$540M DeFi TVL as of Aug 17

Ripe Protocol's two published audits (ChainSecurity Jan2024-Jan2025, Anatomist Oct2025) reviewed architecture that has since shed audited components (Juice Score incentive system, GREEN bonds), and Ripe's own FAQ/audits page does not confirm an audit naming the exact live shipped build
Ripe Protocol raised $1.87M total funding ($1.32M self-funded via Hightop, $550K seed round Feb 2025 at $0.02/RIPE implying ~$20M FDV)
Mick Hagen publicly confirmed he previously operated pseudonymously as "Dre Ham" and ran Mainframe, which reached ~$250M peak market cap and listed on Binance and Upbit
CoinDesk investigative reporting (citing former Terraform Labs colleagues) found Do Kwon co-founded Basis Cash; Hagen created the Basis Cash Discord before Kwon's involvement came to light
Compound's June 2020 COMP liquidity-mining launch is credited as the spark for the term "yield farming"; total DeFi TVL grew roughly 20x from under $1B to ~$20.5B by early January 2021
YAM Finance TVL hit ~$500-600M within 24 hours (Aug 2020); a rebase-contract bug collapsed market cap from ~$475M to ~$19.5M in minutes

SushiSwap's vampire attack migrated roughly $810M (~55%) of Uniswap liquidity in ~11 days; founder Chef Nomi sold his founder allocation for ~$13-14M before backlash forced control transfer to Sam Bankman-Fried
Harvest Finance flash-loan attack drained $24M (later revised to $33.8M); FARM fell 65% in under an hour; protocol TVL fell from over $1B to $430M amid a $570M withdrawal wave
Chainalysis found DeFi-protocol theft rose from ~$162M in 2020 (31% of stolen crypto) to ~$2.2B in 2021 (72% of total)
RWA share of Robinhood Chain TVL fell from ~33% (Jul 7) to 4.1% (Jul 13, Dune-sourced) to 6% (Aug 17, The Block/Dune)

Robinhood Chain recorded ~$570M DEX volume against ~$22M liquidity in its first week; CASHCAT memecoin jumped 1,300-1,700% after CEO Vlad Tenev's post, reaching ~$200M market cap and 3,759% weekly gain by July 11
Robinhood Earn advertises ~7% APY on USDG via Morpho vaults, while the underlying Morpho vault's native rate is closer to 3.23%
Coinbase's Base (launched Aug 2023) has TVL above $5.6B, ~46.6% of all L2 DeFi TVL
Blast's TVL fell 65% within 24 hours of its Feb 2024 mainnet launch (peak $2.2-2.7B to $745M), later declining to ~$105M by mid-2025 and ~$65M by Aug 2025, a 96-97% cumulative decline from peak
Crypto trading fell to ~7.6% of Robinhood's Q2 2026 revenue (down from ~16% a year earlier), crypto revenue fell 38% YoY, while overall revenue hit a record $1.31B

In July 2025 Robinhood distributed "OpenAI" and "SpaceX" stock tokens to EU users; both companies disavowed them and the Bank of Lithuania opened a formal review with no public confirmation of closing found
The SEC's joint divisional statement on tokenized securities (Jan 28, 2026) warns third-party tokenized exposure typically does not convey equity, voting, information or other rights
